service.choose-structure.name: Decide legal structure
service.choose-structure.desc: Sole proprietor (just you) vs a company with partners. This quietly changes several later steps.
service.choose-structure.rule.0.message: Picking 'company' when you meant just yourself asks for directors & articles you don't have.
service.choose-structure.rule.0.mitigati: Pick sole proprietor unless you have partners or need to raise capital.
service.verify-id.name: Verify National ID
service.verify-id.desc: Your identity is the root of every step. Foreigners use a residence permit.
service.verify-id.rule.0.message: An expired ID, or a name spelled differently from the NIDA record, gets rejected.
service.verify-id.rule.0.mitigation: Check your ID is valid and the name matches exactly before starting.
service.verify-id.rule.1.message: Foreign nationals need the right permit (and may only hold land on leasehold).
service.premises.name: Secure proof of premises
service.premises.desc: A lease or land title for where the business will operate. You arrange this yourself.
service.premises.rule.0.message: Reaching the license steps with no lease/title in hand stalls everything.
service.premises.rule.0.mitigation: Sort out premises early — it blocks two later steps.
service.name-res.name: Reserve business name
service.name-res.desc: Check the name is available and allowed.
service.name-res.rule.0.message: Names that clash with an existing business, or use restricted words (Bank, National, Rwanda…), are refused.
service.name-res.rule.0.mitigation: Have two or three backup names ready.
service.biz-reg.name: Register the business (RDB)
service.biz-reg.desc: The actual registration. Free, and issues your certificate + tax number. Most people think this is the whole job — it isn't.
service.biz-reg.rule.0.message: Wrong activity code for what you actually do.
service.biz-reg.rule.0.mitigation: Describe the business plainly; we suggest the right code.
service.biz-reg.rule.1.message: Company route needs full shareholding, directors and articles.
service.biz-reg.rule.1.mitigation: Use the standard articles template if you have no lawyer.
service.vat.name: VAT registration
service.vat.rule.0.message: Crossing the threshold without registering builds up quiet penalties.
service.vat.rule.0.mitigation: Register and get an EBM device when sales grow.
service.trading.name: Trading license (district)
service.trading.desc: A separate annual district license. The RDB certificate does NOT let you operate on its own.
service.trading.rule.1.message: Location not zoned for the activity (e.g. a bar near a school).
service.trading.rule.1.mitigation: Check zoning before signing a lease.
service.sector.name: Health / hygiene permit
service.sector.desc: Food businesses need a hygiene inspection & permit. The step people most often don't know exists.
service.sector.rule.0.message: Opening on just the RDB certificate means operating illegally until an inspector arrives.
service.sector.rule.0.mitigation: You are NOT done until this permit is in hand.
service.rssb.name: Register staff with RSSB
service.rssb.desc: Social security registration once you employ people.
service.rssb.rule.0.message: Hiring without registering staff is a liability on inspection.
service.bank.name: Open business bank account
service.bank.desc: Needs your certificate, TIN and ID.
service.bank.rule.0.message: Banks refuse if the registered name doesn't match your ID.
service.ebm.name: Get EBM e-invoicing device
service.ebm.desc: Electronic billing device for VAT-registered businesses.
service.verify-title.name: Verify land title & ownership
service.verify-title.desc: Confirm the seller is really the registered owner of the parcel (UPI).
service.verify-title.rule.0.message: If the title isn't in the seller's name, the sale can't proceed.
service.verify-title.rule.0.mitigation: Look up the UPI and confirm the owner before paying anything.
service.encumbrance.name: Encumbrance / dispute check
service.encumbrance.desc: Is the parcel mortgaged, under caveat, or disputed? Buyers routinely skip this and pay first.
service.encumbrance.rule.0.message: A mortgage, caveat or dispute blocks the transfer until cleared.
service.encumbrance.rule.0.mitigation: Always run this check before money changes hands.
service.mortgage.name: Mortgage release / bank consent
service.mortgage.desc: If the land secures a loan, the lender must release or consent.
service.mortgage.rule.0.message: No settled loan / written lender consent → blocked.
service.mortgage.rule.0.mitigation: Start the lender conversation early; it's slow.
service.spousal.name: Obtain spousal consent
service.spousal.desc: Under community-of-property marriage the spouse must consent to the sale.
service.spousal.rule.0.message: A married seller selling without the spouse's consent is the #1 land-transfer rejection.
service.spousal.rule.0.mitigation: Get the spouse's signed, notarized consent before the agreement.
service.coowner.name: Co-owner / family consent
service.coowner.desc: Co-owned or family land needs every co-owner's consent.
service.coowner.rule.0.message: Any co-owner who hasn't consented can block the sale.
service.coowner.rule.0.mitigation: List all co-owners from the title and collect each consent.
service.land-tax.name: Land tax / lease-fee clearance
service.land-tax.desc: Outstanding land lease fees & property tax must be cleared first — a frequent surprise.
service.land-tax.rule.0.mitigation: Pull the balance owed on the parcel and settle it.
service.notarize.name: Notarize the sale agreement
service.notarize.desc: Authenticate the contract. Required consents must be attached.
service.notarize.rule.0.message: An unauthenticated agreement, or missing consents, is refused.
service.notarize.rule.0.mitigation: Bring all consents to the notary.
service.pay-transfer.name: Pay land transfer fee
service.pay-transfer.rule.0.message: Wrong fee or unmatched payment causes rework.
service.pay-transfer.rule.0.mitigation: We compute the expected fee and payment reference.
service.apply-transfer.name: Apply for transfer (RLMUA)
service.apply-transfer.desc: The step people THINK is 'the transfer'. RLMUA updates the register and issues the new title.
service.apply-transfer.rule.0.message: Submitting without every required attachment gets rejected.
service.apply-transfer.rule.0.mitigation: We only let you submit once everything for your situation is ready.
service.hospital-notice.name: Get hospital birth notification
service.hospital-notice.desc: The maternity facility issues a notification of birth — the source document the registrar needs.
service.hospital-notice.rule.0.message: Leaving the facility without the notification means coming back for it.
service.hospital-notice.rule.0.mitigatio: Ask for the notification before you go home.
service.home-witness.name: Arrange home-birth witnesses
service.home-witness.desc: A birth outside a health facility is proven with witnesses and confirmation from your cell, instead of a hospital notification.
service.home-witness.rule.0.message: No hospital notification and no witnesses means the registrar can't confirm the birth.
service.home-witness.rule.0.mitigation: Line up witnesses and your cell leader's confirmation early.
service.parents-record.name: Gather both parents' IDs
service.parents-record.desc: Both parents' National IDs are needed to link the child to its parents.
service.marriage-link.name: Bring parents' marriage certificate
service.marriage-link.desc: When the parents are married, their marriage certificate records the child under both parents automatically.
service.paternity-ack.name: Father acknowledges the child
service.paternity-ack.desc: When parents aren't married, the father must formally acknowledge the child for his name to appear — otherwise the child is registered under the mother only.
service.paternity-ack.rule.0.message: Skipping this leaves the father off the certificate, which is hard to fix later.
service.paternity-ack.rule.0.mitigation: Sort out acknowledgement before the declaration if the father is to be named.
service.court-order.name: Get court order for late birth
service.court-order.desc: Past the legal 30-day window, a birth can only be registered with a court ruling — a long detour many families don't expect.
service.court-order.rule.0.message: After 30 days the registrar cannot register the birth without a court order.
service.court-order.rule.0.mitigation: Declare within 30 days to avoid court entirely.
service.birth-declare.name: Declare the birth (sector)
service.birth-declare.desc: Declare the birth at the sector civil registry. This is the core step — within 30 days it's quick and free.
service.birth-declare.rule.0.message: Late declarations are refused without the court order.
service.birth-declare.rule.0.mitigation: Bring the court ruling if the child is over 30 days old.
service.birth-issue.name: Get the birth certificate
service.birth-issue.desc: The civil registrar issues the certificate — your goal.
service.passport-type.name: Choose passport type & apply
service.passport-type.desc: Pick ordinary passport or East African travel document, new or renewal, and start the online application.
service.passport-type.rule.0.message: Picking the wrong type or category means redoing the application.
service.passport-type.rule.0.mitigation: Most travellers need the ordinary passport.
service.minor-docs.name: Gather the child's documents
service.minor-docs.desc: A child's passport needs the birth certificate, both parents' IDs, and signed guardian consent — gather these before enrolment.
service.minor-docs.rule.0.message: Missing parental consent or birth certificate stops a minor's application.
service.minor-docs.rule.0.mitigation: Both parents (or legal guardian) must consent for a minor.
service.surrender-old.name: Surrender your old passport
service.surrender-old.desc: Renewals require handing in the old passport (or a police report if it was lost) — easy to overlook.
service.surrender-old.rule.0.message: A renewal without the old passport (or loss report) is held up.
service.surrender-old.rule.0.mitigation: Bring the old passport; report it first if lost.
service.passport-pay.name: Pay the passport fee
service.passport-pay.desc: Pay based on the service speed you chose. Express costs more but is much faster.
service.passport-pay.rule.0.mitigation: Only pay for express if you truly need the speed.
service.passport-biometrics.name: Capture biometrics
service.passport-biometrics.desc: Photo, fingerprints and signature captured at an enrolment centre.
service.passport-biometrics.rule.0.messa: Non-compliant photos (glasses, headwear) are rejected on the spot.
service.passport-biometrics.rule.0.mitig: Follow the photo rules: no glasses, plain background.
service.passport-approval.name: Vetting & printing
service.passport-approval.desc: Immigration vets the application and prints the passport. Express applications are prioritized here.
service.passport-issue.name: Collect your passport
service.passport-issue.desc: Pick up your finished passport — your goal.
service.license-category.name: Choose licence category
service.license-category.desc: Motorcycle (A), car (B) or commercial (C/D) — your category sets which test and medical you need.
service.foreign-convert.name: Convert your foreign licence
service.foreign-convert.desc: Holders of a valid foreign licence can convert it instead of sitting the theory and practical exams — many don't realise this shortcut exists.
service.foreign-convert.rule.0.message: An expired or unrecognised foreign licence can't be converted — you'd take the full exams instead.
service.foreign-convert.rule.0.mitigatio: Check your licence is valid and from a recognised country.
service.medical.name: Get medical fitness certificate
service.medical.desc: A certificate of fitness to drive — often forgotten until exam day, when it's required to sit.
service.medical.rule.0.message: Applicants who arrive for the practical without a medical are turned away.
service.medical.rule.0.mitigation: Get it before you book the practical exam.
service.theory-exam.name: Pass the theory exam
service.theory-exam.desc: Pass the highway-code theory test to earn your provisional permit.
service.theory-exam.rule.0.message: Failing means re-booking and re-paying for another sitting.
service.theory-exam.rule.0.mitigation: Practise with the official question bank first.
service.practical-exam.name: Pass the practical exam
service.practical-exam.desc: The on-road driving test. You need a provisional permit and a valid medical to sit.
service.practical-exam.rule.0.message: Booking before you've practised enough usually means a re-sit.
service.practical-exam.rule.0.mitigation: Log real practice hours on a provisional permit first.
service.pay-license.name: Pay the licence fee
service.pay-license.desc: Pay the issuance fee once you've passed (or converted).
service.license-issue.name: Get your driving licence
service.license-issue.desc: The licence is printed and issued — your goal.
service.celibacy.name: Get certificate of celibacy
service.celibacy.desc: Each partner proves single status at their sector — a step couples often discover only when booking.
service.celibacy.rule.0.message: An unresolved prior marriage blocks this certificate.
service.celibacy.rule.0.mitigation: Each partner gets their own celibacy certificate from their sector.
service.prior-marriage.name: Prove a prior marriage ended
service.prior-marriage.desc: If either partner was married before, you need the divorce decree or the late spouse's death certificate.
service.prior-marriage.rule.0.message: Without proof a prior marriage ended, the new marriage can't be registered.
service.prior-marriage.rule.0.mitigation: Track down the divorce ruling or death certificate early — it can be slow.
service.foreigner-impediment.name: Certificate of no impediment
service.foreigner-impediment.desc: A foreign partner needs a certificate of no impediment from their embassy, plus valid residence — the longest pole for mixed couples.
service.foreigner-impediment.rule.0.mess: Many embassies are slow to issue this; without it the ceremony can't go ahead.
service.foreigner-impediment.rule.0.miti: Start with the foreign partner's embassy weeks in advance.
service.matrimonial-regime.name: Choose your property regime
service.matrimonial-regime.desc: Couples choose how property is owned (community of property, limited community, or separation) before a notary. Skipped by many, it quietly shapes everything you own together.
service.matrimonial-regime.rule.0.messag: No explicit choice defaults you to full community of property.
service.matrimonial-regime.rule.0.mitiga: Discuss and decide the regime before the ceremony.
service.marriage-book.name: Book the marriage & banns
service.marriage-book.desc: Book a date with the civil registrar. Your intention to marry (banns) is published for a notice period before the date.
service.marriage-book.rule.0.message: The banns notice period means you can't marry on short notice.
service.marriage-book.rule.0.mitigation: Book well ahead of any planned celebration.
service.witnesses.name: Arrange two witnesses
service.witnesses.desc: A civil marriage needs two witnesses with valid IDs present on the day.
service.marriage-celebrate.name: Civil marriage ceremony
service.marriage-celebrate.desc: The registrar celebrates the marriage and issues the certificate — your goal.
